action.action-desc: Ms. Pettersen introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on the Judiciary

form.official-title: To amend title 28 to include additional limitations on the intentional tort exception, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Weaponization Offender Claims Ban Act of 2026.
Section 2680(h) of title 28, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking Any claim and inserting (1) Any claim;
by inserting subject to paragraph (2), before with regard to acts; and
by adding at the end the following:

A private individual may only bring such a claim if such individual has not been convicted of (without regard to whether that person was pardoned or any sentence entered against that person was commuted)—

subparagraph.text: assault or battery against a Federal law enforcement officer;
an offense related to interference with the administration, certification, or counting of a Federal election;
an offense related to obstruction, interference, or unlawful influence over a Federal governmental process;
any felony offense related to any confrontation with a Federal law enforcement officer; or
any felony offense involving theft, embezzlement, misuse of Federal funds, obstruction of Federal oversight or investigative activities, or interference with appropriations or budgetary processes.
